title: Hold an authority to generate or transmit electricity
what: Generate electricity, or own or operate an electricity network, only under a licence from the Utilities Commission.

sources.title: Electricity Reform Act 2000 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on operations in the electricity supply industry for which a licence is required unless the person holds a licence under this Part authorising the relevant operations

sources.title: Electricity Reform Act 2000 (NT)
sources.quote: The operations in the electricity supply industry for which a licence is required are: (a) generation of electricity; (b) owning or operating an electricity network or a dedicated connection asset

sources.title: Electricity Reform Act 2000 (NT)

sources.quote: Commission means the Utilities Commission established by the Utilities Commission Act 2000.
